title: Analogue alarm: How synthetic paneer takes a Gondola ride to your plate
content: Synthetic paneer production continues in Gondola village despite a statewide ban.  Food safety teams are actively monitoring the area for illegal operations.  This analogue product is widely distributed to Delhi-NCR's food businesses and catering kitchens.  Concerns about health impacts and poor standards are driving regulatory action.  Restaurants are now urged to ensure menu transparency regarding ingredients used.

title: Congress-NC rift over Vande Mataram: The ghost of 1987 and ‘big brother’ complex
content: The alliance between the NC and Congress is witnessing persistent tensions regarding political leadership. Recent arguments over the Vande Mataram reveal significant ideological rifts. Echoes of past events, such as the contentious 1987 election, continue to influence NC's political behavior. The long-term success of this coalition hinges on its ability to balance conflicting priorities as they tackle statehood and Article 370 challenges.

title: 'Felt ashamed': Gadkari on highway delay, vows record for blacklisting contractors
content: Nitin Gadkari said on Wednesday that he wanted to "set a record" by blacklisting the largest possible number of contractors and suspending officials found responsible for delays or poor-quality execution in infrastructure projects.

title: 10 biggest features of Apple's first foldable phone, iPhone Duo
content: Apple has unveiled its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, featuring a large 7.6-inch inner display. This new device incorporates a titanium frame and a redesigned hinge mechanism for durability. The iPhone Duo boasts the powerful A20 Pro chip and an advanced 48MP Fusion camera system. It runs on the updated iOS 27, offering enhanced multitasking and Apple Intelligence features.

title: Harshit Rana ruled out as Yash Thakur named replacement for Afg T20Is, Asian Games
content: Harshit Rana has faced yet another setback as he has been ruled out of the upcoming series because of a new injury. Yash Thakur is set to take his place in the squads for the T20Is against Afghanistan and the Asian Games. Rana's previous injuries, including issues with his hamstring and knee, kept him from playing in the T20 World Cup.

title: iPhone Duo, 18 Pro & Pro Max launched: Check India prices, availability, other details
content: Apple has launched its first foldable iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro models.  The iPhone Duo features a large inner display and a smaller outer screen.  iPhone 18 Pro models boast a new 48MP camera and extended battery life.  All devices run on the powerful A20 Pro chip and offer eSIM-only functionality.  Pre-orders and availability dates for India have been announced for these new iPhones.

title: 3 Russian aircraft touch down at Noida airport ahead of Brics summit
content: Russian transport aircraft landed at Noida International Airport ahead of the upcoming BRICS Summit. President Vladimir Putin is expected to visit New Delhi for the multilateral event. He is also scheduled for a bilateral meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday. The leaders will discuss bilateral relations and expand cooperation between the two nations. Russia supports greater cooperation among member countries and the idea of inviting new members.

title: 1980s AI photo trend: 11 ChatGPT prompts to turn photos into retro Bollywood looks
content: Users are transforming photos into 1980s Bollywood styles using ChatGPT.  This trend recreates vintage movie hero and heroine looks with specific prompts.  It allows for creating magazine covers and wedding album pictures easily.  Detailed prompts ensure authentic hairstyles, clothing, and lighting effects.  Users should check AI creations before sharing them online.

title: India crush Pakistan 19-0 to storm into Women’s Hockey Junior Asia Cup semi-finals
content: The defending champions had already topped their group after beating Japan, Malaysia and South Korea. They will now face the winner of the South Korea vs Malaysia quarter-final for a place in the final.

title: Missouri volunteers sank 93 cedar piles to rebuild fish habitat in Truman Lake
content: Truman Lake in Missouri is undergoing remarkable enhancements for its underwater habitat. Recently, 93 cedar brush piles have been established to provide refuge and food for fish. The goal is to install a total of 450 habitat structures throughout the reservoir, backed by a $75,000 grant aimed at improving fishing experiences. Various organizations and community volunteers are joining forces for this multi-year initiative.

title: Baltimore replaces invasive pear with tulip poplar as official tree after 52 years
content: Baltimore has replaced the Chanticleer pear, its official tree since 1974, with the native tulip poplar after Maryland banned sales of the invasive callery pear. Six native species competed for the title, with residents voting before the winner was announced through a costumed tree race at Cylburn Arboretum attended by hundreds.

title: Anthropic researcher who quit over AI safety walked away before his stock vested
content: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon quit over AI safety fears two months before his equity vested, forfeiting his stake as the company heads for a reported $2 trillion IPO. The 27-year-old ex-OpenAI researcher said both labs are racing to self-improving superintelligence. Axios reported the forfeited shares. Anthropic alignment lead Evan Hubinger publicly agreed, putting the odds of AI killing all humans above 10 percent within the decade. Anthropic has not commented.

title: Before 9/11, families could walk to airport gates; 25 years later, it’s returning
content: A new TSA pilot programme is allowing eligible TSA PreCheck members to enter airport gate areas without buying a flight ticket. The Gateside by TSA PreCheck programme is being tested at 13 US airports, including Mesa Gateway Airport in Arizona. Visitors must get a single-day pass and complete the same security screening as ticketed travellers.

title: 'Attacking without verifying not correct': HC to CJP leader on Gaurav Bhatia post
content: The Delhi High Court on Thursday asked the defendants in a defamation case filed by senior advocate and BJP leader Gaurav Bhatia whether they were willing to voluntarily take down the disputed social media posts, observing that there are different ways of protesting and that criticism should be expressed in a more articulate manner.

title: Strong housing demand drives 7,700-plus acres of residential land deals
content: More than 7,700 acres were transacted for housing projects between January 2021 and March 2026.  Overall, 18,158 acres were transacted across 880 deals in 33 cities.  Outright purchases accounted for the largest share of these significant land transactions.  Partnership-led structures and long-lease agreements also contributed to the overall land deals.  These transactions supported residential, commercial, and industrial development across India.

title: 'Mirzapur: The Movie' BO day 7: Pankaj Tripathi film eyes Rs 150 crore India net
content: 'Mirzapur The Movie' has continued its steady climb at the box office, entering Day 7 with its India net collection touching close to Rs. 139 crore. After a blockbuster opening weekend, the Pankaj Tripathi and Ali Fazal starrer has settled into a typical weekday rhythm, adding smaller but consistent numbers each day. With the film now firmly in its second week of release, the focus has shifted to whether it can hold enough screens and audience interest to make a genuine push toward the Rs. 150 crore milestone.

title: Dance, assailants & a party: How ‘killer bahu’ orchestrated father-in-law’s murder
content: A woman allegedly orchestrated her father-in-law's murder while attending a party with her husband.  She reportedly communicated with the assailants throughout the night, guiding their actions.  The plot stemmed from a dispute over CCTV cameras installed for security purposes.  The accused allegedly provided keys and facilitated entry for the hired killers.  Police arrested the woman and two accomplices following an investigation and encounter.

title: US and Philippine marines train with BrahMos to deter China
content: US and Philippine forces recently trained together simulating the BrahMos anti-ship missile. This exercise involved building a kill chain using drones and ground-based missiles. The Philippine Marines are developing tactics for the BrahMos, acquired in 2022. Meanwhile, the US Marine Corps is participating in a multilateral exercise in Indonesia. India's Army is also involved in this Indonesian wargame, focusing on secure sea lanes.

title: UP horror: 7-month-pregnant woman beaten to death by husband
content: A pregnant woman was allegedly beaten to death by her husband in Uttar Pradesh's Hardoi district. The domestic dispute escalated, leading to the fatal assault with a wooden stick. The woman's mother-in-law was also injured while attempting to intervene and stop the violence. Neighbours rushed to the scene and transported the injured woman to a local health center.

title: Gurgaon PG owner shot dead in front of wife, kids; ex-Army man held
content: An ex-serviceman was arrested in Delhi for allegedly shooting a PG operator. The fatal shooting occurred Tuesday evening over a significant monetary dispute between the two men. Police teams swiftly apprehended the accused hours after the incident took place. The victim had reportedly borrowed a substantial sum of money from the arrested individual. Investigations are ongoing to recover the weapon used in the crime.

title: 15 years after restaurant fire, insurer told to pay owner Rs 52.6 lakh
content: A consumer commission ordered New India Assurance to pay over Rs 52 lakh to a restaurant owner. The restaurant owner had approached the commission after a fire destroyed his establishment in 2011. The insurer had initially settled the claim for a much lower amount, which was disputed. The commission found the insurer's depreciation calculation unjustified and the settlement inadequate.

title: Gold, silver price prediction: Why gold, silver are under pressure; check outlook
content: Gold and silver price prediction today: Gold prices may continue to trade within a consolidation range in the short term; however, a decisive breakdown from this phase could trigger another leg of selling.

title: Billion-dollar boom: 6 sectors powering 'India’s New Industrial Revolution'
content: Jefferies has identified several policy measures that it believes are helping these newer sectors expand, driving India’s next phase of industrial growth. These include allowing greater private-sector participation in space, providing tax holidays for data centres.

title: Taxman seized woman’s gold, diamonds and silver; how she won case in ITAT
content: The matter began after the woman filed her income tax return (ITR) on August 12, 2019, declaring an income of Rs 1.34 lakh. However, around a year before she filed the return, the Income Tax Department came across information about her while conducting a search at the offices of a company.

title: US states sue Trump administration, accuse it of ‘illegally’ weakening wildlife law
content: In a significant legal move, twenty US states along with Washington DC have taken action against the Trump administration by filing lawsuits that contest new regulations perceived to undermine protections under the federal Endangered Species Act. These cases, initiated in federal courts around San Francisco, claim the modifications are arbitrary and infringe upon established environmental regulations.

title: 'I didn't see any benefits': Chidambaram questions 2026 Brics; draws BJP's flak
content: With India set to host the Brics Summit 2026 in Delhi, Chidambaram said the country is part of several major international groupings but questioned whether they had delivered concrete gains for India. "I don't know how many Presidents and how many Prime Ministers are coming. I don't think the last two or three Brics summits have resulted in tangible benefits or tangible results,” Chidambaram told news agency ANI.

title: Red Fort blast case: How bomber planned to make explosives using urine
content: NIA chargesheet details Red Fort blast accused Umar-un-Nabi's unusual urine storage.  He stored urine in a polythene bag while hiding in Nuh.  This detail emerged after a foul smell prompted a house owner's complaint.  The agency found PDF material on his pen drives detailing urea nitrate explosive preparation.  This revived Ansar Ghazwat-ul-Hind module was allegedly led by Nabi.

title: Mumbai cat killings: 20 found dead; Rs 50k reward to trace mystery killer(s)
content: Nearly twenty cats were found killed and mutilated in Chembur's Panjrapole area. Local caregiver Rubeena Pathan reported the disturbing discovery to the police. PETA India has announced a reward for information leading to the culprits' arrest. Police are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the perpetrators of this cruelty. The case is registered under animal cruelty and penal code sections.

title: Musk’s estranged daughter takes aim at father and AI in new fashion campaign
content: Vivian Wilson, daughter of billionaire Elon Musk, leads a provocative fashion campaign that takes aim at artificial intelligence. The new advertisement humorously highlights the limitations of robots in understanding human emotions. This initiative is particularly significant given her complicated relationship with Musk. Wilson raises alarms about AI's effects on creative employment and the environment while promoting the beauty of human flaws and critically examining AI's expanding footprint.

title: Iran war to outlast Trump 2.0? Top aides sound alarm despite his 'quick end' claim
content: Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio were among the advisers who reportedly raised the possibility during private discussions with Trump in the Oval Office and Situation Room. According to the report, the officials told Trump that Iran could continue resisting US pressure, potentially keeping the conflict going until after the next US presidential inauguration in January 2029.

title: ‘Bunch of liars’: Allahabad HC raps UP cops over illegal detention
content: The Allahabad High Court criticized Deoria police officials for alleged illegal detention.  The court expressed disappointment over missing CCTV footage from the police station.  It directed the UP government to pay Rs 65,000 to the four petitioners.  The court noted that actions were taken after the petition was filed.  The bench questioned the release of full payment for the CCTV system.

title: Nandan Nilekani, heading exam reform panel, named in SIR's 'no-mapping’ category
content: Nandan Nilekani, 71, is the co-founder and chairman of Bengaluru-based Infosys. He was also the founding chairman of the Unique Identification Authority of India, which issues Aadhaar cards, serving with the rank of Cabinet minister in the Congress-led central government from 2009 to 2014. He was appointed co-chair of the G20 Task Force on Digital Public Infrastructure for Economic Transformation, Financial Inclusion, and Development in January 2023.

title: Triptii Dimri spotted in IShowSpeed's livestream at Apple event
content: Actress Triptii Dimri gained social media attention after appearing in a livestream. She attended Apple's recent launch event in California, interacting with new devices. Dimri was photographed alongside singer AP Dhillon and Apple CEO John Ternus. The actress is preparing for her role in the upcoming film 'Spirit'. She is also expected to feature in the movie 'Animal Park' next.

title: ‘Lal Mandir was original target’: How traffic forced Red Fort bomber to change plans
content: The National Investigation Agency filed a charge sheet detailing the Red Fort vehicle-borne IED attack.  The bomber initially targeted Lal Mandir but was diverted by traffic and police presence.  He detonated the explosive near Red Fort Gate No. 4, killing eleven people.  The device was triggered remotely using a mechanism fitted into the bomber's shoe.  This attack was the first vehicle-borne IED incident reported in the national capital.

title: Apple's 1st foldable phone launched: Specifications & price in India of iPhone Duo
content: Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable phone, at Rs 2,99,900 in India. It opens to a 7.6-inch display with a 5.4-inch screen outside, runs the A20 Pro chip, and carries a battery on each side for up to 24 hours of use. Touch ID replaces Face ID, and the phone is eSIM-only. Pre-orders open on October 16, with sales from October 23.

title: Neeraj, 19, was trapped under Delhi PG rubble; his family spotted him on TV
content: In a harrowing event in Satya Niketan, Delhi, rescuers saved a 19-year-old student trapped beneath rubble after a building collapse. The brave young man used his phone to send his live location to friends. His sister recognized him by a rakhi on his wrist. Currently in critical condition at AIIMS, his family remains hopeful as the investigation unfolds to understand the cause of the tragedy.

title: 'Wonder if I should become a cockroach': Mallya cries 'injustice' over bank dues
content: Mallya, who is living in London, made the remarks while responding to the legal proceedings against him and defending his position on the recovery of money owed to banks by his now-defunct Kingfisher Airlines. He cited an Enforcement Directorate (ED) affidavit that he claimed was filed before the Bombay HC and alleged that the agency had confirmed the recovery of more than Rs 14,000 crore and its transfer to banks.

title: Bali tour never conducted after payment; Kerala panel orders Rs 1.12 lakh payout
content: A Kerala consumer commission ordered a travel agency to refund Rs 82,500. The agency failed to conduct a Bali tour booked by a customer. This failure constituted deficiency in service and unfair trade practice. The commission also awarded compensation for mental agony and litigation costs. The travel agency must pay the total amount within forty-five days.

title: 'Ramayana' gets early Australia release amid 'Godzilla' clash
content: Ramayana's international release date has been moved forward to November 5, 2026. This advance allows the Indian epic a one-day head start over Godzilla Minus Zero. Godzilla Minus Zero will open in cinemas on November 6, following its Japanese release. Ramayana Part 1 is set for an Indian Diwali release on November 8. Part 2 of the epic film is scheduled for Diwali 2027.

title: Spanish intelligence warned of ‘mass entry’ day before 70k reached Ceuta
content: Spanish intelligence experts raised alarms about a potential mass migrant crossing into Ceuta, revealing through declassified documents that notices were issued just a day before the event took place. These alerts highlighted social media campaigns urging a significant breach of the border. Government representatives have since claimed they lacked insight into the true magnitude of the influx, igniting political tensions regarding their response.
